reason: The 24 /piloto/ pages and production checkout code are prepared assets, but the parent offer decision remains VALIDATE, provider mappings are empty, production flags are off and no versioned evidence authorizes a real-money canary. Preserve the reversible asset while founder-led demand and external approvals are proved.

criteria.measure: Issue #88 has a versioned EXECUTE decision naming the canary offer and approved spend
criteria.threshold: EXECUTE with one named offer and spend ceiling

criteria.measure: Founder-led manual channel records qualified willingness to buy the named offer at approved terms
criteria.threshold: >= 1 qualified commercial opportunity; aggregate record only, no PII in this contract

criteria.measure: Legal, fiscal/NFS-e, delivery-capacity and security approvals are versioned
The named offer has provider mapping plus sandbox, negative-path and rollback evidence
criteria.threshold: Provider mapping complete for one offer and all required gates green

sunset_rule: If the review does not justify another DEFER or EXECUTE decision, publish a versioned URL-by-URL MIGRATE/REDIRECT/RETIRE plan for all 24 pages. A blanket redirect to the home page is forbidden.
rollback: Keep catalog, checkout, webhook and real-money flags false; keep ASAAS_MODE disabled in production. This DEFER schema cannot authorize checkout or rollback receive-only. A later EXECUTE needs a separate reviewed schema and implementation with production_evidence=true, durable cumulative limits and individual authority for every real charge, refund and cancellation. Revert to the last known-good deploy.
